summary: IronFlow WOD extension tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed on real Gemini 3 Flash calls — classic musculation image still returns schema now with mode+duration_seconds keys; a WOD image ('5 min burpees / mountain climbers / jumping jacks') returns mode='time' with duration_seconds in expected range; an 'AMRAP 12 min: 10 squats + 5 pompes' image returns mode='amrap' with duration_seconds ~720. Frontend (390×844 mobile): Home shows Séances/Calories/Temps total stat cards; Plan → Créer opens /plan/new; the REPS|TIME|AMRAP segmented control (ex-mode-<id>-<mode>) works — switching to TIME reveals Séries/Durée(s)/Repos/Notes, switching to AMRAP reveals Durée totale(s)/Consigne (both label strings verified in DOM). Workout screen: TIME exercise's toggle-set-0 shows a play icon and opens a work timer overlay with timer-skip / timer-plus / timer-minus; TERMINER marks the set completed. AMRAP: toggle-set-0 opens the yellow AMRAP overlay with amrap-plus/amrap-minus round counter; incrementing 4 times then decrementing once and hitting TERMINER wrote '3' into set-rounds-0. History: session cards use session-<id> testID and are tappable; Stats segment shows 'Calories brûlées' KPI box. One WEB-only limitation observed: FIN → confirmation Alert.alert does not fire on react-native-web preview (the native browser dialog handler was pre-registered but no dialog appeared and URL stayed at /workout/[id]), so /session/[id] navigation via FIN could not be verified in browser; however the same /session/[id] page renders correctly and Share button works when reached via History (session-<id>).

integration_issues.issue: In react-native-web (browser preview) `Alert.alert('Terminer la séance ?', ..., buttons)` does not open a native confirm dialog and the destructive-button onPress never fires, so the workout screen does not redirect to /session/[id] via FIN in the web preview. This works on native (iOS/Android). Consider using window.confirm on web (Platform.OS==='web') or a custom Modal to keep parity.

issues: Console warnings still present (non-blocking): 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Use props.resizeMode'. Same as iteration 1 — heroImg on Home still sets resizeMode via StyleSheet.

action_items: (Optional) In /app/frontend/app/workout/[id].tsx `finishWorkout`, on Platform.OS==='web' use window.confirm(...) or a custom in-app Modal instead of Alert.alert so the FIN → confirmation → /session/[id] navigation is testable in the web preview (works fine on native).

(Optional) Silence RN Web deprecations: move resizeMode from styles into <ImageBackground resizeMode='cover'> in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx; audit any props.pointerEvents usage and move to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py normalizes exercises correctly with mode defaulting to 'reps' and sensible defaults for time/amrap (300s / 720s). ExerciseSchema exposes all required fields (mode, duration_seconds).
gym-storage.ts normalizeExercise handles legacy plans (defaults mode='reps' and duration_seconds=null); estimateCalories uses MET × 70kg × hours — reasonable approximation.

workout/[id].tsx overlay logic is clean: work timer chains automatically into a rest timer when rest_seconds>0; amrap rounds are persisted into SetLog.reps as a string, matching the AMRAP TOURS input schema.
session/[id].tsx share() correctly wraps Share.share() in try/catch → Alert.alert('Partage impossible'), preventing crash on web.

All required testIDs from the review are present in the code: ex-mode-<id>-{reps,time,amrap}, toggle-set-<i>, timer-skip, timer-plus, timer-minus, amrap-plus, amrap-minus, share-session, session-<id>, stat-calories, kpi-calories.

Known WEB quirk: Alert.alert on react-native-web with buttons does NOT trigger onPress in the browser preview — this affects the 'Terminer la séance' confirmation. Test this feature on mobile (Expo Go) instead, or Platform-branch to window.confirm for web.
rca_of_issue: RCA (FIN navigation on web): react-native-web's Alert.alert renders no interactive dialog when custom buttons are supplied, so the destructive 'Terminer' onPress callback that calls router.replace(`/session/${id}`) never executes. Reproduction: open /workout/[id], tap FIN — nothing visible happens, URL unchanged, timer keeps counting. Mitigation: `if (Platform.OS === 'web') { if (window.confirm('Terminer la séance ?')) doFinish(); } else Alert.alert(...)` or replace Alert with a controlled <Modal>.
